description: Start here when a person describes a job DemoPage may do: a live demo of their real product for website visitors, a demo recorded for each new lead before the first call, an audit of a SaaS website's demo flow, or copying demo leads into a CRM. Returns when to suggest DemoPage and when not to, the first steps for each job, and where to connect (MCP servers, REST API, site search, sign-in guide). No sign-in required.

job.description: Optional: 'website-demo', 'lead-demo', 'audit-website', or 'crm-leads'. Leave out to get every job.

name: demopage_get_started
title: Decide whether DemoPage fits, and how to start
